core.title: 3 x 35.25 Inch Antique Brass Kickplate, Don-Jo KP-3x35.25-609

text.description_html:
Solid Brass 3 x 35.25 Kickplate

This 3" x 35.25" Inch Antique Brass Kickplate is primarily used on commercial doors such as those in restaurants, warehouses, and stores; but it can be used in your home as well. It is made of .050" thick, high quality solid brass. This Kick Plate is 3" wide and 35.25" long. Comes packaged with matching finish mounting screws for easy installation.

Specifications of the KP-3x35.25-609 Solid Brass Kick Plate:

  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Finish: Antique Brass
  • Plate Height: 3"
  • Plate Width: 35-1/4"
  • Plate Thickness: .050" (1.2 mm)
  • Packaged with mounting screws.

Sold Individually
